_note: This page restates a number from every page it links to, so every claim here re-runs against THAT PAGE'S OWN shipped data file and then checks the derived file this page renders from against the same recomputation. A correction upstream fails this page's gate instead of leaving a stale tile behind, and a derive script that was not re-run fails it too. The pattern is index/claims.json's; the paths climb out of cluster-health/data/ on purpose.

claims.text: Scale tile and hero card 1: 24,030 jobs in the measurement register across the twelve counties in 2025, counted in 24 of the 36 industry-county cells.
claims.source: BLS QCEW annual averages, NAICS 3252 + 3255 + 326, PIC-12, via wages/data/wages.json
claims.assert: (lambda rows, ly: round(sum(r['emp'] for r in rows if r['year'] == ly)) == 24030 and len([r for r in rows if r['year'] == ly]) == 24 and len(set(r['area'] for r in rows)) * 3 == 36)([r for r in D['wg']['trend'] if r['area'] != 'US000' and r['naics'] in ('3252', '3255', '326')], max(r['year'] for r in D['wg']['trend'])) and D['h']['tiles'][0]['value'] == '24,030' and D['h']['register']['possible_cells'] == 36
claims.actual: (sum(r['emp'] for r in D['wg']['trend'] if r['area'] != 'US000' and r['naics'] in ('3252', '3255', '326') and r['year'] == max(x['year'] for x in D['wg']['trend'])), D['h']['tiles'][0]['value'])
claims.falsified_if: A QCEW revision moves the register total by one job, BLS discloses or withholds one more cell, or derive_health.py is not re-run after either. The hero prints the total to the job, so the tolerance is zero.

claims.text: Scale tile and the callout: 12 of the 36 industry-county cells are withheld, and the total is a floor rather than a count of every job.
claims.source: BLS QCEW disclosure behaviour, via wages/data/wages.json and location-quotient/data/lq.json
claims.assert: 36 - len([r for r in D['wg']['trend'] if r['area'] != 'US000' and r['naics'] in ('3252', '3255', '326') and r['year'] == max(x['year'] for x in D['wg']['trend'])]) == 12 and sum(c['counties_suppressed'] for c in D['lq']['composite'] if c['register'] == 'core' and c['year'] == max(x['year'] for x in D['lq']['composite'])) == 12
claims.actual: (36 - len([r for r in D['wg']['trend'] if r['area'] != 'US000' and r['naics'] in ('3252', '3255', '326') and r['year'] == 2025]), sum(c['counties_suppressed'] for c in D['lq']['composite'] if c['register'] == 'core' and c['year'] == 2025))
claims.falsified_if: The two source files stop agreeing on how many register cells BLS withheld, which would mean one of them is counting a withheld cell as an observation. The word 'floor' on the tile is not survivable if the withheld count reaches zero.

claims.text: Scale tile and the H1: employment fell for a third straight year, and the fall in the cells counted in both years is 802 jobs, 3.3 percent.
claims.source: BLS QCEW annual averages, cells present in all eleven years, via wages/data/wages.json
claims.assert: (lambda rows, ys: (lambda bal: bal[ys[-1]] - bal[ys[-2]] == -802 and bal[ys[-2]] < bal[ys[-3]] and bal[ys[-3]] < bal[ys[-4]] and bal[ys[-4]] > bal[ys[-5]] and round((bal[ys[-1]] / bal[ys[-2]] - 1) * 100, 1) == -3.3)({y: sum(r['emp'] for r in rows if r['year'] == y and len(set(q['year'] for q in rows if q['area'] == r['area'] and q['naics'] == r['naics'])) == len(ys)) for y in ys}))([r for r in D['wg']['trend'] if r['area'] != 'US000' and r['naics'] in ('3252', '3255', '326')], sorted(set(r['year'] for r in D['wg']['trend']))) and D['h']['tiles'][0]['direction']['value'] == -802 and D['h']['tiles'][0]['direction']['streak'] == 3

claims.falsified_if: Any revision that turns one of the three falls into a rise, or moves the latest step off exactly 802 jobs. The streak is counted on the balanced panel, so a disclosure change alone cannot create or destroy it; a real revision can.

claims.text: Scale tile: the 802-job fall is larger than seven of the nine earlier year-to-year moves, and two have been larger. A typical year moves 341 jobs; the widest earlier move is 1,047.
claims.source: Derived in cluster-health/derive_health.py from the balanced panel in wages/data/wages.json
claims.assert: D['h']['tiles'][0]['band']['median_prior'] == 341 and D['h']['tiles'][0]['band']['max_prior'] == 1047 and D['h']['tiles'][0]['band']['beats'] == 7 and D['h']['tiles'][0]['band']['n_prior'] == 9 and D['h']['tiles'][0]['band']['verdict'] == 'above' and abs(D['h']['tiles'][0]['band']['typicals'] - 802 / 341) < 0.001
